title: Class-level transaction propagation on event listeners
summary: Event listener creation now rejects class-level REQUIRED. The method-level NOT_SUPPORTED override refreshed and received exactly one fallback event outside a transaction.

change.description: Validate the effective transaction propagation when creating a transactional event listener, including the annotation on its containing class.

notes: The forbidden and permitted method controls call the factory directly. The delivery history registers a managed listener with transaction management enabled.
